meta.title: "Enter The Jiangyu"
meta.description: Hehehe, the kung fu starlet Jiangyu is here, atatatatatata—

units.rawText: In the Oasis' Projection Room.
units.displayText: In the Oasis' Projection Room.

spans.text: In the Oasis' Projection Room.

units.rawText: Pardon me, Professor.
units.displayText: Pardon me, Professor.

spans.text: Pardon me, Professor.

units.rawText: Ah, you're here, Daiyan. Please, have a seat.
units.displayText: Ah, you're here, Daiyan. Please, have a seat.

spans.text: Ah, you're here, Daiyan. Please, have a seat.

units.rawText: Did you call me over to discuss the details regarding the upcoming Mid-Autumn festivities?
units.displayText: Did you call me over to discuss the details regarding the upcoming Mid-Autumn festivities?

spans.text: Did you call me over to discuss the details regarding the upcoming Mid-Autumn festivities?

units.rawText: To think it would be Mid-Autumn Festival again. Time sure flies, doesn't it? However, considering you've just come back from outside the sector, it's best for you to get some rest.
units.displayText: To think it would be Mid-Autumn Festival again. Time sure flies, doesn't it? However, considering you've just come back from outside the sector, it's best for you to get some rest.

spans.text: To think it would be Mid-Autumn Festival again. Time sure flies, doesn't it? However, considering you've just come back from outside the sector, it's best for you to get some rest.

units.rawText: Fufu, if it's unrelated to that, then could it possibly be that you wish to ask me out on a date?
units.displayText: Fufu, if it's unrelated to that, then could it possibly be that you wish to ask me out on a date?

spans.text: Fufu, if it's unrelated to that, then could it possibly be that you wish to ask me out on a date?

units.rawText: That certainly wouldn't be out of the question if the opportunity came around, but...
units.displayText: That certainly wouldn't be out of the question if the opportunity came around, but...

spans.text: That certainly wouldn't be out of the question if the opportunity came around, but...

units.rawText: This isn't for my sake; rather, it's for you. I'd like to invite you to watch a movie with me.
units.displayText: This isn't for my sake; rather, it's for you. I'd like to invite you to watch a movie with me.

spans.text: This isn't for my sake; rather, it's for you. I'd like to invite you to watch a movie with me.

units.rawText: Oh, most certainly. However, I'm quite curious as to what kind of movie would have you go out of your way like this.
units.displayText: Oh, most certainly. However, I'm quite curious as to what kind of movie would have you go out of your way like this.

spans.text: Oh, most certainly. However, I'm quite curious as to what kind of movie would have you go out of your way like this.

units.rawText: You'll find out once you see it.
units.displayText: You'll find out once you see it.

spans.text: You'll find out once you see it.

units.rawText: As those words leave my mouth, I pick up the remote and turn the monitor on.
units.displayText: As those words leave my mouth, I pick up the remote and turn the monitor on.

spans.text: As those words leave my mouth, I pick up the remote and turn the monitor on.

units.rawText: Amidst the gently-falling snowflakes, a sprightly, beautiful girl appears on the screen.
units.displayText: Amidst the gently-falling snowflakes, a sprightly, beautiful girl appears on the screen.

spans.text: Amidst the gently-falling snowflakes, a sprightly, beautiful girl appears on the screen.

units.rawText: Upon seeing her, Daiyan's ever-present expression of elegant serenity suddenly cracks.
units.displayText: Upon seeing her, Daiyan's ever-present expression of elegant serenity suddenly cracks.

spans.text: Upon seeing her, Daiyan's ever-present expression of elegant serenity suddenly cracks.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Jiangyu</color>...?! Could she be...
units.displayText: Jiangyu...?! Could she be...

spans.text: Jiangyu
...?! Could she be...

units.rawText: Shhh—Please, be quiet when watching the movie.
units.displayText: Shhh—Please, be quiet when watching the movie.

spans.text: Shhh—Please, be quiet when watching the movie.

units.rawText: Once it is done, all the questions you have may be answered.
units.displayText: Once it is done, all the questions you have may be answered.

spans.text: Once it is done, all the questions you have may be answered.

units.rawText: Daiyan watches the girl walking on the screen and then looks at me. Then, she takes a deep breath and clutches the hems of her dress.
units.displayText: Daiyan watches the girl walking on the screen and then looks at me. Then, she takes a deep breath and clutches the hems of her dress.

spans.text: Daiyan watches the girl walking on the screen and then looks at me. Then, she takes a deep breath and clutches the hems of her dress.

units.rawText: How could I possibly spurn your generosity after all you've said...
units.displayText: How could I possibly spurn your generosity after all you've said...

spans.text: How could I possibly spurn your generosity after all you've said...

units.rawText: Very well. I will watch this film with you in silence.
units.displayText: Very well. I will watch this film with you in silence.

spans.text: Very well. I will watch this film with you in silence.

units.rawText: Upon those words, Daiyan turns back to the screen.
units.displayText: Upon those words, Daiyan turns back to the screen.

spans.text: Upon those words, Daiyan turns back to the screen.

units.rawText: That familiar face makes her recall memory data from the past, and the scenes from her recollections overlap with those on the screen...
units.displayText: That familiar face makes her recall memory data from the past, and the scenes from her recollections overlap with those on the screen...

spans.text: That familiar face makes her recall memory data from the past, and the scenes from her recollections overlap with those on the screen...

units.rawText: Jiangyu, you don't need to let those reviews get to you. The mistake was with the Doll design team, which was why you couldn't handle performing. It isn't your fault.
units.displayText: Jiangyu, you don't need to let those reviews get to you. The mistake was with the Doll design team, which was why you couldn't handle performing. It isn't your fault.

spans.text: Jiangyu, you don't need to let those reviews get to you. The mistake was with the Doll design team, which was why you couldn't handle performing. It isn't your fault.

units.rawText: Try and relax a little. I made some osmanthus tarts for you...
units.displayText: Try and relax a little. I made some osmanthus tarts for you...

spans.text: Try and relax a little. I made some osmanthus tarts for you...

units.rawText: You don't get it, Big Sis.
units.displayText: You don't get it, Big Sis.

spans.text: You don't get it, Big Sis.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: You're a perfect CM-ENT unit: elegant, demure, well-read, understanding, and highly skilled. As for me...
units.displayText: You're a perfect CM-ENT unit: elegant, demure, well-read, understanding, and highly skilled. As for me...

spans.text: You're a perfect CM-ENT unit: elegant, demure, well-read, understanding, and highly skilled. As for me...

units.rawText: I can't even play a full piece on the guzheng.
units.displayText: I can't even play a full piece on the guzheng.

spans.text: I can't even play a full piece on the guzheng.

units.rawText: Jiangyu, you are my little sister, so even if you can't play normally, I can handle your part for you...
units.displayText: Jiangyu, you are my little sister, so even if you can't play normally, I can handle your part for you...

spans.text: Jiangyu, you are my little sister, so even if you can't play normally, I can handle your part for you...

units.rawText: That's enough, Big Sis!
units.displayText: That's enough, Big Sis!

spans.text: That's enough, Big Sis!

units.rawText: "The mistake was with the design team", "handle your part"... If I really accept all that...
units.displayText: "The mistake was with the design team", "handle your part"... If I really accept all that...

spans.text: "The mistake was with the design team", "handle your part"... If I really accept all that...

units.rawText: ...Then wouldn't I be admitting I was a mistake...
units.displayText: ...Then wouldn't I be admitting I was a mistake...

spans.text: ...Then wouldn't I be admitting I was a mistake...

units.rawText: Jiangyu...
units.displayText: Jiangyu...

spans.text: Jiangyu...

units.rawText: ...I need some time by myself. Please, Big Sis.
units.displayText: ...I need some time by myself. Please, Big Sis.

spans.text: ...I need some time by myself. Please, Big Sis.

units.rawText: In the dimly lit room, Jiangyu removes the script booklet she's using to cover her face and looks up at the blank, white ceiling.
units.displayText: In the dimly lit room, Jiangyu removes the script booklet she's using to cover her face and looks up at the blank, white ceiling.

spans.text: In the dimly lit room, Jiangyu removes the script booklet she's using to cover her face and looks up at the blank, white ceiling.

units.rawText: ...Big Sis might be naggy, but I guess I really went too far by saying that...
units.displayText: ...Big Sis might be naggy, but I guess I really went too far by saying that...

spans.text: ...Big Sis might be naggy, but I guess I really went too far by saying that...

units.rawText: Still, I can't apologize now! Since I've made up my mind, what'll happen if I see Big Sis again and lose the will to go...
units.displayText: Still, I can't apologize now! Since I've made up my mind, what'll happen if I see Big Sis again and lose the will to go...

spans.text: Still, I can't apologize now! Since I've made up my mind, what'll happen if I see Big Sis again and lose the will to go...

units.rawText: Jiangyu sighs heavily, then looks back at the script. She can't make heads or tails of the densely-packed characters there.
units.displayText: Jiangyu sighs heavily, then looks back at the script. She can't make heads or tails of the densely-packed characters there.

spans.text: Jiangyu sighs heavily, then looks back at the script. She can't make heads or tails of the densely-packed characters there.

units.rawText: <size=28>All I do is hold you back. Is that really what a little sister does...?</size>
units.displayText: All I do is hold you back. Is that really what a little sister does...?

spans.text: All I do is hold you back. Is that really what a little sister does...?

units.rawText: Knock, knock—
units.displayText: Knock, knock—

spans.text: Knock, knock—

units.rawText: Who is it?
units.displayText: Who is it?

spans.text: Who is it?

units.rawText: Who is it? It's me! YOUR MANAGER!
units.displayText: Who is it? It's me! YOUR MANAGER!

spans.text: Who is it? It's me! YOUR MANAGER!

units.rawText: I sent God knows how many messages to you; the least you could do is reply to them! None of them were even read! I was starting to wonder if you'd been kidnapped!
units.displayText: I sent God knows how many messages to you; the least you could do is reply to them! None of them were even read! I was starting to wonder if you'd been kidnapped!

spans.text: I sent God knows how many messages to you; the least you could do is reply to them! None of them were even read! I was starting to wonder if you'd been kidnapped!

units.rawText: Ah, erm... I was too engrossed in studying the script. I'm so sorry about that—
units.displayText: Ah, erm... I was too engrossed in studying the script. I'm so sorry about that—

spans.text: Ah, erm... I was too engrossed in studying the script. I'm so sorry about that—

units.rawText: ...(Sigh) What the heck was the design team thinking; how could a Doll like you ever play a classical instrument?
units.displayText: ...(Sigh) What the heck was the design team thinking; how could a Doll like you ever play a classical instrument?

spans.text: ...(Sigh) What the heck was the design team thinking; how could a Doll like you ever play a classical instrument?

units.rawText: They wanted a second Daiyan; instead, they got someone who couldn't even play a tune.
units.displayText: They wanted a second Daiyan; instead, they got someone who couldn't even play a tune.

spans.text: They wanted a second Daiyan; instead, they got someone who couldn't even play a tune.

units.rawText: Aw, don't be mad. If you REALLY need me to play, I can manage somehow.
units.displayText: Aw, don't be mad. If you REALLY need me to play, I can manage somehow.

spans.text: Aw, don't be mad. If you REALLY need me to play, I can manage somehow.

units.rawText: So why did you rush all the way here? Could it be that...
units.displayText: So why did you rush all the way here? Could it be that...

spans.text: So why did you rush all the way here? Could it be that...

units.rawText: Yup, I got you a place for an audition.
units.displayText: Yup, I got you a place for an audition.

spans.text: Yup, I got you a place for an audition.

units.rawText: Woohoo!!
units.displayText: Woohoo!!

spans.text: Woohoo!!

units.rawText: Wait, wait, wait, don't celebrate just yet. This is just a screen test; you still need to pass it.
units.displayText: Wait, wait, wait, don't celebrate just yet. This is just a screen test; you still need to pass it.

spans.text: Wait, wait, wait, don't celebrate just yet. This is just a screen test; you still need to pass it.

units.rawText: Jiangyu's manager can't help but sigh as she watches the girl raise her script and cheer.
units.displayText: Jiangyu's manager can't help but sigh as she watches the girl raise her script and cheer.

spans.text: Jiangyu's manager can't help but sigh as she watches the girl raise her script and cheer.

units.rawText: While I feel that asking the company to "cancel your guzheng performances and switch to the film industry" was a bold move...
units.displayText: While I feel that asking the company to "cancel your guzheng performances and switch to the film industry" was a bold move...

spans.text: While I feel that asking the company to "cancel your guzheng performances and switch to the film industry" was a bold move...

units.rawText: You have to understand the kind of risk you're taking here and the price to be paid for it. You're not a professional movie Doll, so you've fallen behind others just by your nature alone.
units.displayText: You have to understand the kind of risk you're taking here and the price to be paid for it. You're not a professional movie Doll, so you've fallen behind others just by your nature alone.

spans.text: You have to understand the kind of risk you're taking here and the price to be paid for it. You're not a professional movie Doll, so you've fallen behind others just by your nature alone.

units.rawText: If it wasn't because they required guzheng skills for the character they're auditioning for, you wouldn't even have gotten this chance.
units.displayText: If it wasn't because they required guzheng skills for the character they're auditioning for, you wouldn't even have gotten this chance.

spans.text: If it wasn't because they required guzheng skills for the character they're auditioning for, you wouldn't even have gotten this chance.

units.rawText: Relax, I understand!
units.displayText: Relax, I understand!

spans.text: Relax, I understand!

units.rawText: (Sigh) If you mess up this time, the company is going to seriously consider recalling you. Daiyan was helping to deflect the company's criticisms in the past, but then you had to go out of your way and mention this...
units.displayText: (Sigh) If you mess up this time, the company is going to seriously consider recalling you. Daiyan was helping to deflect the company's criticisms in the past, but then you had to go out of your way and mention this...

spans.text: (Sigh) If you mess up this time, the company is going to seriously consider recalling you. Daiyan was helping to deflect the company's criticisms in the past, but then you had to go out of your way and mention this...

units.rawText: <size=28>I mean, it's not like I can actually stand on the stage by myself if I'm always hiding behind Big Sis' skirts, right?</size>
units.displayText: I mean, it's not like I can actually stand on the stage by myself if I'm always hiding behind Big Sis' skirts, right?

spans.text: I mean, it's not like I can actually stand on the stage by myself if I'm always hiding behind Big Sis' skirts, right?

units.rawText: What did you say? On stage? Don't you think you're setting your sights too far ahead? Given the present circumstances you're lucky the company didn't scrap you on the spot.
units.displayText: What did you say? On stage? Don't you think you're setting your sights too far ahead? Given the present circumstances you're lucky the company didn't scrap you on the spot.

spans.text: What did you say? On stage? Don't you think you're setting your sights too far ahead? Given the present circumstances you're lucky the company didn't scrap you on the spot.

units.rawText: (Whimper) Just consider it a little obsession of mine, okay?
units.displayText: (Whimper) Just consider it a little obsession of mine, okay?

spans.text: (Whimper) Just consider it a little obsession of mine, okay?

units.rawText: Alright, alright, enough messing with you. Since you've got the slot, you'd better go prepare yourself!
units.displayText: Alright, alright, enough messing with you. Since you've got the slot, you'd better go prepare yourself!

spans.text: Alright, alright, enough messing with you. Since you've got the slot, you'd better go prepare yourself!

units.rawText: Jiangyu smiles and nods before pushing her manager out, and the two of them leave the room together.
units.displayText: Jiangyu smiles and nods before pushing her manager out, and the two of them leave the room together.

spans.text: Jiangyu smiles and nods before pushing her manager out, and the two of them leave the room together.

units.rawText: Just before the door closes, she steals one last look at the photo frame on the table.
units.displayText: Just before the door closes, she steals one last look at the photo frame on the table.

spans.text: Just before the door closes, she steals one last look at the photo frame on the table.

units.rawText: In it, Jiangyu and Daiyan are touching foreheads and smiling brightly.
units.displayText: In it, Jiangyu and Daiyan are touching foreheads and smiling brightly.

spans.text: In it, Jiangyu and Daiyan are touching foreheads and smiling brightly.

units.rawText: (If I can't go on stage, I really can't be your little sister.)
units.displayText: If I can't go on stage, I really can't be your little sister.

spans.text: If I can't go on stage, I really can't be your little sister.

units.rawText: (Give me some time, Big Sis.)
units.displayText: Give me some time, Big Sis.

spans.text: Give me some time, Big Sis.

units.rawText: (I want to be able to hold my head up with pride and stand by your side.)
units.displayText: I want to be able to hold my head up with pride and stand by your side.

spans.text: I want to be able to hold my head up with pride and stand by your side.

units.rawText: In Canada, in a rental car.
units.displayText: In Canada, in a rental car.

spans.text: In Canada, in a rental car.

units.rawText: Jiangyu is seated in the rear, spacing out as she stares at the dolls in her hand.
units.displayText: Jiangyu is seated in the rear, spacing out as she stares at the dolls in her hand.

spans.text: Jiangyu is seated in the rear, spacing out as she stares at the dolls in her hand.

units.rawText: ...Alright, I understand. Thank you very much. I'll bring her over right now.
units.displayText: ...Alright, I understand. Thank you very much. I'll bring her over right now.

spans.text: ...Alright, I understand. Thank you very much. I'll bring her over right now.

units.rawText: Her manager hangs up then looks back at Jiangyu.
units.displayText: Her manager hangs up then looks back at Jiangyu.

spans.text: Her manager hangs up then looks back at Jiangyu.

units.rawText: Are you looking at those dolls again? (Sigh) If you miss her so much, then you should call her.
units.displayText: Are you looking at those dolls again? (Sigh) If you miss her so much, then you should call her.

spans.text: Are you looking at those dolls again? (Sigh) If you miss her so much, then you should call her.

units.rawText: But... but wouldn't that mean telling her I came to Canada?
units.displayText: But... but wouldn't that mean telling her I came to Canada?

spans.text: But... but wouldn't that mean telling her I came to Canada?

units.rawText: Daiyan's going to find out even if you don't tell her.
units.displayText: Daiyan's going to find out even if you don't tell her.

spans.text: Daiyan's going to find out even if you don't tell her.

units.rawText: It's not like I'm scared of Big Sis nagging me... Ahhhh, that's enough of that! How did it go? Who were you talking to just now?
units.displayText: It's not like I'm scared of Big Sis nagging me... Ahhhh, that's enough of that! How did it go? Who were you talking to just now?

spans.text: It's not like I'm scared of Big Sis nagging me... Ahhhh, that's enough of that! How did it go? Who were you talking to just now?

units.rawText: Another actor. She's a proper actress Doll with experience in movies, and she's secured a part for herself.
units.displayText: Another actor. She's a proper actress Doll with experience in movies, and she's secured a part for herself.

spans.text: Another actor. She's a proper actress Doll with experience in movies, and she's secured a part for herself.

units.rawText: Since she's a Doll and you'll be on the same crew, she was willing to live in the same dorm as you. That way, she can mentor you too.
units.displayText: Since she's a Doll and you'll be on the same crew, she was willing to live in the same dorm as you. That way, she can mentor you too.

spans.text: Since she's a Doll and you'll be on the same crew, she was willing to live in the same dorm as you. That way, she can mentor you too.

units.rawText: As it happens, we've just arrived, so you'll be seeing her soon.
units.displayText: As it happens, we've just arrived, so you'll be seeing her soon.

spans.text: As it happens, we've just arrived, so you'll be seeing her soon.

units.rawText: The two of them get out of the car and find a dark-haired Doll waiting for them at the dorm entrance.
units.displayText: The two of them get out of the car and find a dark-haired Doll waiting for them at the dorm entrance.

spans.text: The two of them get out of the car and find a dark-haired Doll waiting for them at the dorm entrance.

units.rawText: It must have been a long journey. Hope you had a good trip.
units.displayText: It must have been a long journey. Hope you had a good trip.

spans.text: It must have been a long journey. Hope you had a good trip.

units.rawText: Hello. Jiangyu, this is the senior I was telling you about.
units.displayText: Hello. Jiangyu, this is the senior I was telling you about.

spans.text: Hello. Jiangyu, this is the senior I was telling you about.

units.rawText: Ohhh! Hello, Miss! I'm Jiangyu, and I'll be in your care from now on.
units.displayText: Ohhh! Hello, Miss! I'm Jiangyu, and I'll be in your care from now on.

spans.text: Ohhh! Hello, Miss! I'm Jiangyu, and I'll be in your care from now on.

units.rawText: Oh, that's fine. No need to be so tense; we're from the same company, so we need to look out for each other.
units.displayText: Oh, that's fine. No need to be so tense; we're from the same company, so we need to look out for each other.

spans.text: Oh, that's fine. No need to be so tense; we're from the same company, so we need to look out for each other.

units.rawText: The name's Nascita. Nice to meet you!
units.displayText: The name's Nascita. Nice to meet you!

spans.text: The name's Nascita. Nice to meet you!
